svg.title: Typical vertebra: superior view with lateral inset
svg.desc: Main panel: the shared vertebral plan from above, with body/anterior at the top and spinous process at the bottom. Inset: a thoracic lateral detail with upper and lower costal demifacets on the posterior body margin, an attached inferior articular facet, and a disc between adjacent bodies. Anterior is toward the viewer's left. The inferior costal facet is shown only in this lateral detail, not as a visible superior surface.
